purpose: Stress-test deterministic secondary failures while keeping proxy load separate from calibrated traffic or interdependent infrastructure.

execution_tiers.name: Single-network proxy-load cascade
execution_tiers.method: edge-betweenness load, fixed tolerance and iterative removal

primary_sources.citation: Motter and Lai (2002), Cascade-based attacks on complex networks
Buldyrev et al. (2010), Catastrophic cascade of failures in interdependent networks

known_limitations: The base load is weighted edge betweenness.
Tolerance, iteration and per-stage caps are recorded.
A static topology proxy is not a causal cascade forecast.
